definitions.explanation: A general term for green leafy vegetables used in cooking, such as spinach, komatsuna, bok choy, and similar greens.

examples.japanese: {青菜|あおな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧。
⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{青菜|あおな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I added leafy greens to the miso soup.

examples.japanese: {青菜|あおな}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れたい→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧。
examples.english: Leafy greens are nutritious, so I want to include them in my daily meals.

notes:
A collective term for green leafy vegetables, combining ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (green/blue) and {菜|な} (vegetable). In Japanese cooking, {青菜|あおな} encompasses vegetables like ⟦{小松菜|こまつな}→小松菜：12520_komatsuna⟧, ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧, {青梗菜|ちんげんさい}, and similar greens.

USAGE:
Commonly used in recipes and cooking contexts. When a recipe calls for {青菜|あおな}, the cook can choose whichever leafy green is available. The word also appears in the proverb {青菜|あおな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (lit. 'salt on greens'), meaning to look wilted or dejected.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青菜|あおな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{炒|いた}め{物|もの}→炒め物：08537_itamemono⟧ — stir-fried greens
- {青菜|あおな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おひたし — blanched greens in broth
- {青菜|あおな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ — looking dejected (idiom)
